correctness.rationale: The polar radial law f_k(r)=k*sinh(k*r)/(cosh(kR)-1) has boundary density b=k*coth(kR/2), and antipodal angle defect w is uniform on [0,pi]. The exact hyperbolic cosine rule converts D>2R-eps on radial deficits u+v<eps to 1-cos w<q=(eps-u-v)/(2a)(1+O(eps)), with a=tanh(kR)/(4k) and a=R/4 flat. Angular aperture w_max/pi equals sqrt(eps-u-v)/(pi sqrt(a)) times 1+O(eps). Integrate the triangular radial slacks: integral sqrt(eps-u-v)=4 eps^(5/2)/15, hence C=4 b^2/(15 pi sqrt(a)) and the stated formulas. The change W=a*w^2/eps yields W^-1/2 simplex density 15/8 and Dirichlet(1,1,1/2,1), with independent angular marks. The log derivative of coefficient ratio is 5/(2z)-2/sinh(z)-1/sinh(2z)>0. Reviewed full actual source checker, which computes exact angular aperture via 2D quadrature but is finite corroboration, not infinity proof.
